title: pluginval and format smoke-load script (VST3/CLAP strictness 8+, LV2/Standalone)
description:
Add a pluginval + format smoke-load runner per Build Spec §14 item 10. Wave-1 independent; scripts only.

Before editing, inspect:
- scripts/build_all.sh (CLion-bundled cmake discovery; cmake is not on PATH)
- CMakeLists.txt / CMakePresets.json for artifact output locations (VST3, CLAP, LV2, Standalone)
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §10 (formats) and §14 item 10
- Sibling pluginval runners under /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/ if present

Implement scripts/run_pluginval.sh:
1. Bash script, set -euo pipefail, repo-root friendly: `bash scripts/run_pluginval.sh`.
2. Resolve tools without assuming `cmake` or `pluginval` on PATH:
   - Prefer sourcing/reusing discovery logic from scripts/build_all.sh or duplicating the CLion cmake locator pattern.
   - Locate pluginval via common paths, PLUGINVAL env override, or build tree; print a clear error if missing.
3. Strictness 8+ on VST3 and CLAP artifacts (pluginval --strictness-level 8 or higher). Fail the script if either fails.
4. LV2 and Standalone: smoke-load only (pluginval light options, or `--validate-in-process` / load-only invocation if strict full suite is unstable for those formats). Document the distinction in script comments.
5. Accept optional build-dir / config args; default to the repo's usual RelWithDebInfo/CLion binary dir layout from presets/build_all.
6. Print which binaries were tested and PASS/FAIL per format; exit non-zero on any required failure.

Do not edit CMakeLists, C++ sources, presets, or docs. Do not run an unbounded full host matrix (manual per §14).
acceptance_criteria: scripts/run_pluginval.sh exists and is a bash script with a shebang
scripts/run_pluginval.sh runs pluginval at strictness 8+ on VST3 and CLAP artifacts
scripts/run_pluginval.sh smoke-loads LV2 and Standalone (documented as smoke, not full strict suite if applicable)
scripts/run_pluginval.sh resolves cmake/pluginval via build_all.sh / CLion / env overrides and does not require bare cmake on PATH
Script exits non-zero when a required VST3/CLAP pluginval run fails and prints per-format diagnostics
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: claim full DAW host matrix coverage inside the script

allowed: reuse build_all.sh cmake locator by sourcing or copy-paste of the lookup block
skip gracefully with non-zero and message if artifacts not built yet
forbidden: edit plugin sources to pass validation
download pluginval via network as a hard dependency without offline path
